title: Compact remediation witness
objective: Emit a compact, versioned remediation record and verify mixed historic and compact chains without rewriting any immutable evidence.

phases.title: Compact protocol producer
phases.objective: Define and emit the strongly typed v2 record that replaces a full result snapshot with deterministic operation replay evidence.

tasks.title: Define and emit compact remediation v2
tasks.description: Add the closed v2 remediation-record contract and change new remediation plans to emit it without embedding a SprintFile snapshot.
tasks.context: v1 records are immutable and remain readable. v2 must have an explicit strongly typed witness/discriminant, preserve all commitment and provenance fields, and retain only the state digest plus typed operation replay evidence needed for deterministic verification.
acceptance_criteria: New remediate preview and apply plans produce a schemaVersion 2 record with no full SprintFile result snapshot.
The v2 record validator rejects unknown fields and malformed witness data with field-specific diagnostics.
Existing v1 records continue to parse through their v1 validator without mutation.

evidence.summary: Defined the closed v2 compact remediation record and emit a typed operations-replay witness instead of a full SprintFile snapshot.
evidence.validation: OPENSSL_CONF=/private/tmp/kyro-empty-openssl.cnf npm run build; npm run check:compact-remediation-witness (9 assertions); npm run check:replay-witness (5 assertions); npm run typecheck

checked_criteria: New remediate preview and apply plans produce a schemaVersion 2 record with no full SprintFile result snapshot.
The v2 record validator rejects unknown fields and malformed witness data with field-specific diagnostics.
Existing v1 records continue to parse through their v1 validator without mutation.

phases.title: Mixed-chain replay
phases.objective: Replay each record using its immutable protocol version rather than a stored full state image.

tasks.title: Verify mixed v1 and compact chains
tasks.description: Refactor remediation inspection and rebase to dispatch v1 and v2 records explicitly, replay v2 operations directly, and keep doctor/status fail-closed.
tasks.context: A v2 record has no state snapshot. Chain replay must derive its result from the checkpoint/base and typed operations, compare every declared digest, and reject unknown versions or forged compact witnesses before a scope can report remediated or recertified.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor and status verify genuine v1→v2 and v2→v2 remediation chains without rewriting historic records.
A forged operation, digest, witness, or unknown record version makes the scope fail closed rather than remediated or recertified.
Replay preserves checkpoint, legacy snapshot, narrative, and ledger bytes.

evidence.summary: Replayed compact v2 operations directly while preserving versioned v1 snapshot replay; all remediation chains now replay before verification claims remediated.
evidence.validation: OPENSSL_CONF=/private/tmp/kyro-empty-openssl.cnf npm run build; npm run check:scope-remediation (304 assertions); npm run check:verification-states (162 assertions); npm run check:compact-remediation-witness (9 assertions); npm run check:replay-witness (5 assertions); npm run typecheck

checked_criteria: Doctor and status verify genuine v1→v2 and v2→v2 remediation chains without rewriting historic records.
A forged operation, digest, witness, or unknown record version makes the scope fail closed rather than remediated or recertified.
Replay preserves checkpoint, legacy snapshot, narrative, and ledger bytes.

phases.title: Growth and debt certification
phases.objective: Prove compact records bound archive growth and close only the debt demonstrated by the new evidence.

tasks.title: Certify bounded compact archives
tasks.description: Extend the real remediation harness with deterministic size and schema assertions, wire it into the full check, and resolve the scope debt items only when the relevant proof passes.
tasks.context: Bounded means new v2 records do not duplicate the full live SprintFile; it does not claim a historical migration. Tests must use real close/remediate flows and prove growth is linear in record payloads rather than quadratic in repeated snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: A multi-record v2 chain proves no v2 record contains a full SprintFile snapshot and demonstrates bounded incremental archive growth.
The complete check suite covers v1 compatibility, v2 replay, unknown-version rejection, and immutable-history byte preservation.
debt-1 and debt-2 are resolved through Kyro only after their corresponding acceptance evidence passes.

evidence.summary: Certified four-link compact v2 archive growth, wired compact witness coverage into the full check, and resolved both evidenced remediation debts through Kyro.
evidence.validation: OPENSSL_CONF=/private/tmp/kyro-empty-openssl.cnf npm run check (passed); npm run check:scope-remediation (307 assertions); npm run check:compact-remediation-witness (9 assertions); npm run check:verification-states (162 assertions); npm run check:replay-witness (5 assertions)
evidence.notes: debt-1 and debt-2 were resolved through kyro debt resolve only after the complete suite passed.

checked_criteria: A multi-record v2 chain proves no v2 record contains a full SprintFile snapshot and demonstrates bounded incremental archive growth.
The complete check suite covers v1 compatibility, v2 replay, unknown-version rejection, and immutable-history byte preservation.
debt-1 and debt-2 are resolved through Kyro only after their corresponding acceptance evidence passes.

definitionOfDone: New remediation records use a compact, strongly typed versioned witness and never embed a full SprintFile snapshot.
Doctor and status preserve valid v1 verification and fail closed for malformed, forged, or unsupported v2 evidence.
Real multi-record vectors prove deterministic replay, bounded archive growth, and byte-identical historic close artifacts.
npm run build and npm run check pass.
